description: This Java class 'DefaultMappingConfig' provides the default implementation of the 'MappingConfig' interface, encapsulating configuration parameters such as buffer size, parallelism, max pool size, JavaScript configuration, and mapper limits for the mapping component within the Eclipse Ditto connectivity services.

classes.name: DefaultMappingConfig
classes.description: Immutable class implementing MappingConfig, providing configuration parameters for mapping operations.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates an instance of DefaultMappingConfig from a given Config object, using fallback configuration.

methods.name: getMaxPoolSize
methods.description: Returns the maximum pool size setting.

methods.name: getMapperLimitsConfig
methods.description: Returns the mapper limits configuration object.
